summary: Tennessee Division of Forestry tower in Franklin County, district 5, tower 10 on the 1976 list. Forest Lookouts lists a Franklin County tower named Keith Springs; the link to Rowe Gap is an inference from county and district. Standing in 2014, dismantled in 2017. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Dismantled and removed in November 2017. A move to Bedford County was planned; no other source confirms it.

notes_for_editor: Name pairing: the record joins Rowe Gap (Tennessee Landforms, FRT001) and Keith Springs (Forest Lookouts). The Keith Springs page gives Franklin County, the Division of Forestry and district 5, but no tower number and no elevation, and it does not mention Rowe Gap. Tower 10 comes from the 1976 list on Tennessee Landforms, which gives Franklin County and 1873 ft for Rowe Gap. The join is therefore an inference from county and district. The 2014 extant list names Rowe Gap only. The Bedford County reassembly is stated as planned on one page and is not confirmed; do not add a Bedford County location without a second source. No build year, design, staffing or fire history appears in these sources, so the story leaves them out. Elevation 1873 ft (570.9 m) matches the record.
